predictions.articleTitle: Japan vs Paraguay Tactical Breakdown & Preview: Rotation Fatigue vs Low-Block Defense
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Home Win / Draw alongside Under 2.5 Goals as Japan's +74 Elo advantage and second-half bench depth face Paraguay's rested low-block defense in a tight neutral-venue friendly.
possibilityAssessment: Japan Win or Draw supported by +74 Elo gap, 1.20 vs 1.05 goal lambda, and Paraguay missing Andrés Cubas (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals supported by 2.25 combined lambda, 60.9% Poisson probability, and Paraguay's 0.57 recent decayed GA (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Exact Score 1:1 hedge capturing Paraguay's counter-attacking threat against a Japan defense without a clean sheet in five games (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Rotated Japan attack tests rested Paraguay defense in Kallang.

spf.comment: Covers a narrow 1:0 Japan win driven by second-half depth and a 1:1 stalemate created by Japan's absences and 74-hour turnaround, where a single win call leaves the draw path unprotected.

over_under.comment: Combined goal lambda of 2.25 produces a 60.9% Under 2.5 baseline against Paraguay's compact 29.7% possession defense.

score.comment: Anchors on Japan's frequent one-goal winning margin and the 13.3% Poisson modal 1:1 draw.

goals.comment: Reflects the top two Poisson total-goal buckets at 26.7% and 23.7% probability.

bqc.comment: Both sides score over 61% of goals after half-time, pointing to a level opening 45 minutes before Japan either edge ahead late or share a 1:1 draw.
